analysis.reasonEn: Previous two consecutive buy decisions maintained. RSI 60.3→67.6 rise confirms neutral zone consolidation. SMA5 ($57.36) below current price ($57.53) enters short-term resistance, but SMA20 ($56.66) breakout is expected to act as support. Weekly RSI 67.3 remains in bullish territory. ADX 13.2 indicates no trend formation, but buy bias based on daily/weekly indicator alignment.
